items:
Latitude Adjustment at Blue Mountain Beach by Royal Destinations

Village: Blue Mountain Beach
Address: 17 Sand Dunes Road, Santa Rosa Beach, FL

Details:
Discover the ultimate coastal escape at Latitude Adjustment at Blue Mountain Beach, a stunning newly constructed home in the heart of 30A. Just 0.2 miles from the beach, this retreat invites you to slow down, soak up the sun, and make unforgettable memories with family and friends. Designed for comfort and connection, the home features an open-concept living area that flows seamlessly onto a covered lanai and private pool that is perfect for lazy afternoons or evening gatherings. Enjoy private en suite bedrooms, a top-floor bunk and bonus room for movie nights, and plenty of space for everyone to relax their way. Located within walking distance to restaurants, shopping, and entertainment, Latitude Adjustment at Blue Mountain Beach combines the best of modern luxury and laid-back beach living. With parking for three vehicles, ample dining space, and all the comforts of home (including your morning coffee maker fix), it’s your go-to destination for a 30A vacation to remember.

Home Highlights:
- Distance to Beach Access: 0.2 Miles To Gulf Point Road Beach Access and Blue Mountain Beach Access (5- Minute Walk)
- *Private Heated Pool
- Walk to Restaurants, Shopping, and Entertainment
- 3 Parking Spaces
- Dining Accommodations: 8 at Dining Table, 3 at Kitchen Island
- Coffee Maker Available
* Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax).
* The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees.
* Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay.

Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements:
Sleeps: 16
5 Bedrooms / 5 Full Baths / 1 Half Bath / Outdoor Shower

First Floor:
- Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower)
- Kitchen / Living / Dining Area / Open Living Concept
- Private Pool, Lanai Gathering Area, Outdoor Grill, Outdoor Shower
-Laundry Room

Second Floor:
- Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower)
- Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower)
- Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with Private Bath

Third Floor:
- Bedroom 5: Bunk Room Two (Full/Full) with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo)
- Queen Sleeper Sofa
- Living Area with TV

Amenities Include:
- 6 Adult Bikes
- Beach Towel Service

Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
